verdict.rationale: Brave provides an official MCP server (brave-search-mcp-server) enabling agentic integration and guides for Claude, n8n, Dify, OpenClaw, but there is no evidence of official language SDKs (Python/JS/etc.) or a published OpenAPI spec—probes for openapi.json/swagger.json all 404, implying developers must hand-roll REST calls or use MCP rather than a proper SDK.
